intents.name: 5g_not_available
intents.description: 5G is not available on a 5G-capable device
example_complaints: My phone supports 5G but 5G is not available
The 5G icon never appears on my phone
intents.clarifying_question: Which network mode is selected on the device?

intents.name: account_login
intents.description: Customer cannot sign in to the self-care account
example_complaints: I cannot log in to my account
The app says my login failed
intents.clarifying_question: What message do you see when the login fails?

intents.name: account_security
intents.description: Possible compromise or suspicious account activity
example_complaints: I am concerned about the security of my account
Someone accessed my account without permission
intents.clarifying_question: When did you first notice the suspicious activity?

intents.name: password_reset
example_complaints: I need to reset my account password
I forgot my password
intents.clarifying_question: Can you receive the verification code on your registered contact?

intents.name: profile_update
intents.description: Customer wants to update profile details
example_complaints: I need to update my account profile
I want to change the email on my account
intents.clarifying_question: Which profile field needs to change?

intents.name: billing_dispute
example_complaints: I want to dispute a charge on my bill
I was charged twice this month
intents.clarifying_question: Which billing period and line item is being disputed?

intents.name: payment_failed
example_complaints: My bill payment failed
My card payment keeps getting declined
intents.clarifying_question: Was money deducted from the account even though the payment failed?

intents.name: refund_status
example_complaints: I want to know the status of my refund
My refund has not arrived
intents.clarifying_question: Do you have the refund reference or the original transaction date?

intents.name: unexpected_charge
intents.description: Unrecognised charge appears on the bill
example_complaints: There is an unexpected charge on my bill
I see an extra charge I do not recognise
intents.clarifying_question: What is the name of the line item and which billing period is it on?

intents.name: broadband_disconnects
example_complaints: My broadband keeps disconnecting every evening
The internet connection drops out several times a day
My fibre connection keeps cutting out
intents.clarifying_question: At what time of day do the drops happen, and does the router or ONT show any warning light?

intents.name: broadband_slow
intents.description: Fixed broadband performance is slower than expected
example_complaints: My broadband speed is slow during the evening
Internet is very slow and videos keep buffering
intents.clarifying_question: When does it happen, and is it slow on both Wi-Fi and wired devices?

intents.name: call_drops
example_complaints: My calls keep dropping
Calls get cut after a minute
intents.clarifying_question: Do the calls drop in a specific location or at a specific time?

intents.name: call_quality
example_complaints: People cannot hear me clearly during calls
There is an echo on every call
intents.clarifying_question: Does it affect incoming calls, outgoing calls, or both?

intents.name: visual_voicemail_transcription
intents.description: Visual voicemail transcriptions are missing or stopped working
example_complaints: Visual voicemail transcription stopped working after the carrier settings update
My visual voicemail no longer shows transcriptions of messages
Voicemail transcription text is missing in the visual voicemail app

intents.name: broadband_no_internet
intents.description: Router is connected but there is no internet access
example_complaints: My broadband is connected to the router but there is no internet
Home internet is completely down
intents.clarifying_question: Are the router and ONT lights normal, and is the problem on every device?

intents.name: new_connection_status
intents.description: Status of a new connection or installation
example_complaints: I want to check the status of my new broadband connection
When will my installation happen?
intents.clarifying_question: Do you have the new-connection request reference?

intents.name: service_activation
example_complaints: My service has not activated yet
Activation is still pending
intents.clarifying_question: Do you have the activation request reference?

intents.name: service_outage
example_complaints: I think there may be a service outage in my area
The whole street has no internet
intents.clarifying_question: Which area or postcode is affected?

intents.name: mobile_data_not_working
example_complaints: My mobile data is not working
Mobile internet stopped working on my phone
intents.clarifying_question: Do you see network bars and the mobile data icon on the phone?

intents.name: mobile_data_slow
example_complaints: My mobile data is very slow
4G speed has become extremely slow
intents.clarifying_question: Does the slowdown happen in one location or everywhere?

intents.name: no_signal
intents.description: Device has no mobile network signal
example_complaints: My phone shows no network signal
Phone says no service at home
intents.clarifying_question: Is the no-signal problem in one location, and has the SIM been reseated?

intents.name: plan_change
example_complaints: I want to change my current plan
Please upgrade my plan
intents.clarifying_question: Which plan would you like to move to?

intents.name: plan_information
example_complaints: I want information about available plans
What plans can I choose from?
intents.clarifying_question: Are you interested in mobile or broadband plans?

intents.name: recharge_issue
example_complaints: My recharge did not complete
I topped up but the balance did not update
intents.clarifying_question: Do you have the recharge transaction reference?

intents.name: roaming_not_working
example_complaints: My roaming service is not working
My phone has no service while abroad
intents.clarifying_question: Which country are you in, and is roaming enabled on the line?

intents.name: sim_activation
example_complaints: My new SIM has not activated
I need to activate my new SIM card
intents.clarifying_question: When was the SIM inserted, and was the activation request submitted?

intents.name: sim_not_detected
intents.description: Device does not detect the SIM card
example_complaints: My phone does not detect the SIM
Phone says no SIM card inserted
intents.clarifying_question: Has the SIM been tested in another phone?

intents.name: sim_replacement
intents.description: Customer needs a replacement SIM or eSIM
example_complaints: I need a replacement SIM
My SIM card is damaged and needs replacing
intents.clarifying_question: Is the replacement for a lost, damaged, or changed device?

intents.name: sms_not_received
intents.description: SMS or OTP messages not delivered
example_complaints: I am not receiving SMS messages
OTP messages never arrive on my phone
intents.clarifying_question: Is it incoming SMS, outgoing SMS, or both?

intents.name: router_restart_issue
intents.description: Problem persists after a router restart, or router restarts unexpectedly
example_complaints: I restarted the router but the connection problem remains
My router keeps rebooting by itself
intents.clarifying_question: Which lights does the router show after the restart completes?

intents.name: wifi_not_working
intents.description: Home Wi-Fi unavailable or failing on devices
example_complaints: Wi-Fi is not working on my devices
My phone cannot connect to the home Wi-Fi
intents.clarifying_question: Does the problem affect every device, or only one?

categories.name: Internet
categories.description: Home internet access, outages, activation and installation

categories.name: SIM
categories.description: SIM / eSIM detection, activation and replacement

categories.name: Account
categories.description: Login, password, profile and account security
